mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('measurement_result_seq')
INSERT INTO measurement_result (id, test_result_id, patient_id, measurement_item_id, value, measur_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{testResultId}, #{patientId}, #{measurementItemId}, #{value}, #{measurTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE measurement_result SET value= #{value}, measur_time= #{measurTime}, WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT mr.id , mr.measur_time , mr.measurement_item_id , mr.patient_id , mr.test_result_id , mr.value FROM test_tube_result ttr INNER JOIN test_result tr ON tr.test_tube_result_id = ttr.id INNER JOIN measurement_result mr ON mr.test_result_id = tr.id WHERE 1 = 1 ${searchCondition} ORDER BY mr.measurement_item_id, mr.measur_time DESC

SELECT LEAST (1, count(*)) FROM test_tube_result ttr INNER JOIN test_result tr ON tr.test_tube_result_id = ttr.id INNER JOIN measurement_result mr ON mr.test_result_id = tr.id WHERE ttr.barcode = #{barcode} AND mr.value IS NULL
